# No File Left Behind

> An open pattern for closing several documents at once: ask once, in one list, and never close anything if a save fails. Free to implement in any application, in any language; no code from the project is required.

To implement it in an application, follow the skill. It names everything else you need.

## Implement

- [Skill: implementing the pattern](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/skills/no-file-left-behind/SKILL.md): the steps, the usual mistakes, how to report conformance
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/AGENTS.md): orientation for AI coding assistants

## The pattern

- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/SPEC.md): the rules, MUST/SHOULD/MAY
- [Checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/CHECKLIST.md): one line per rule, for a review
- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/README.md): the pattern in five rules

## Test it

- [Scenario format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/scenarios/README.md)
- [Scenarios](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/scenarios/scenarios.json): the rules as data
- [Reference model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/no-file-left-behind/no-file-left-behind.github.io/main/scenarios/reference/model.mjs): about 150 lines, to port
